asideNextText: Need more than two options? The Random Picker chooses fairly from any list you give it.
asideText: Everything is generated locally in your browser with cryptographic randomness. Nothing is uploaded, stored, or tracked.

faq.a: It uses your browser's cryptographic random generator (crypto.getRandomValues) with rejection sampling and unbiased shuffling — the same quality of randomness used by security software, not the predictable Math.random().
The current run of identical results (for example 'Heads ×4 in a row') and the longest streak of the session so far.
Choose best of 3, 5, or 7 and the flipper tracks the score until one side clinches the series.

heroSubtitle: A fair coin, flipped in your browser — with tallies and streaks if you're settling best-of series.
metaDescription: Flip a virtual coin online — heads or tails with a running tally, streaks and best-of modes. Cryptographically random, free, no sign-up.
title: Coin Flipper — Flip a Coin Online | ToolVerse
whenNotToUse: A coin flip is a tie-breaker, not a decision method — anything with real consequences deserves more thought than 50/50.
Official coin tosses (sports, ceremonies) follow their own rules; this is an everyday virtual equivalent.
